Docs page "Specifying a Disruption Budget for your Application", section "Unhealthy Pod Eviction Policy". ## Unhealthy Pod Eviction Policy

{{< feature-state feature_gate_name="PDBUnhealthyPodEvictionPolicy" >}}

PodDisruptionBudget guarding an application ensures that `.status.currentHealthy` number of pods
does not fall below the number specified in `.status.desiredHealthy` by disallowing eviction of healthy pods.
By using `.spec.unhealthyPodEvictionPolicy`, you can also define the criteria when unhealthy pods
should be considered for eviction. The default behavior when no policy is specified corresponds
to the `IfHealthyBudget` policy.

Policies:

`IfHealthyBudget`
: Running pods (`.status.phase="Running"`), but not yet healthy can be evicted only
  if the guarded application is not disrupted (`.status.currentHealthy` is at least
  equal to `.status.desiredHealthy`).

: This policy ensures that running pods of an already disrupted application have
  the best chance to become healthy. This has negative implications for draining
  nodes, which can be blocked by misbehaving applications that are guarded by a PDB.
  More specifically applications with pods in `CrashLoopBackOff` state
  (due to a bug or misconfiguration), or pods that are just failing to report the
  `Ready` condition.

`AlwaysAllow`
: Running pods (`.status.phase="Running"`), but not yet healthy are considered
  disrupted and can be evicted regardless of whether the criteria in a PDB is met.

Docs page "Specifying a Disruption Budget for your Application", section "Unhealthy Pod Eviction Policy".   disrupted and can be evicted regardless of whether the criteria in a PDB is met.

: This means prospective running pods of a disrupted application might not get a
  chance to become healthy. By using this policy, cluster managers can easily evict
  misbehaving applications that are guarded by a PDB. More specifically applications
  with pods in `CrashLoopBackOff` state (due to a bug or misconfiguration), or pods
  that are just failing to report the `Ready` condition.

{{< note >}}
Pods in `Pending`, `Succeeded` or `Failed` phase are always considered for eviction.
{{< /note >}}

This page is intended for cluster administrators.

{{< glossary_tooltip text="Dynamic Resource Allocation (DRA)" term_id="dra" >}}
lets a cluster manage availability and allocation of hardware resources to
satisfy Pod-based claims for hardware requirements and preferences. To support
this, a mixture of Kubernetes built-in components (like the Kubernetes
scheduler, kubelet, and kube-controller-manager) and third-party drivers from
device owners (called DRA drivers) share the responsibility to advertise,
allocate, prepare, mount, healthcheck, unprepare, and cleanup resources
throughout the Pod lifecycle. These components share information via a series of
DRA specific APIs in the `resource.k8s.io` API group including
{{< glossary_tooltip text="DeviceClasses" term_id="deviceclass" >}},
{{< glossary_tooltip text="ResourceSlices" term_id="resourceslice" >}},

{{< feature-state for_k8s_version="v1.19" state="stable" >}}

Seccomp stands for secure computing mode and has been a feature of the Linux
kernel since version 2.6.12. It can be used to sandbox the privileges of a
process, restricting the calls it is able to make from userspace into the
kernel. Kubernetes lets you automatically apply seccomp profiles loaded onto a
{{< glossary_tooltip text="node" term_id="node" >}} to your Pods and containers.

Identifying the privileges required for your workloads can be difficult. In this
tutorial, you will go through how to load seccomp profiles into a local
Kubernetes cluster, how to apply them to a Pod, and how you can begin to craft
profiles that give only the necessary privileges to your container processes.

Docs page "Restrict a Container's Syscalls with seccomp", section "Enable the use of `RuntimeDefault` as the default seccomp profile for all workloads". ## Enable the use of `RuntimeDefault` as the default seccomp profile for all workloads

{{< feature-state state="stable" for_k8s_version="v1.27" >}}

To use seccomp profile defaulting, you must run the kubelet with the
`--seccomp-default`
[command line flag](/docs/reference/command-line-tools-reference/kubelet)
enabled for each node where you want to use it.

If enabled, the kubelet will use the `RuntimeDefault` seccomp profile by default, which is
defined by the container runtime, instead of using the `Unconfined` (seccomp disabled) mode.
The default profiles aim to provide a strong set
of security defaults while preserving the functionality of the workload. It is
possible that the default profiles differ between container runtimes and their
release versions, for example when comparing those from CRI-O and containerd.

{{< alert color="info" title="Note" >}}
Enabling the feature will neither change the Kubernetes
`securityContext.seccompProfile` API field nor add the deprecated annotations of
the workload. This provides users the possibility to rollback anytime without
actually changing the workload configuration. Tools like
[`crictl inspect`](https://github.com/kubernetes-sigs/cri-tools) can be used to

Docs page "Restrict a Container's Syscalls with seccomp", section "Enable the use of `RuntimeDefault` as the default seccomp profile for all workloads". [`crictl inspect`](https://github.com/kubernetes-sigs/cri-tools) can be used to
verify which seccomp profile is being used by a container.
{{< /alert >}}

Some workloads may require a lower amount of syscall restrictions than others.
This means that they can fail during runtime even with the `RuntimeDefault`
profile. To mitigate such a failure, you can:

- Run the workload explicitly as `Unconfined`.
- Disable the `SeccompDefault` feature for the nodes. Also making sure that
  workloads get scheduled on nodes where the feature is disabled.
- Create a custom seccomp profile for the workload.

If you were introducing this feature into production-like cluster, the Kubernetes project
recommends that you enable this feature gate on a subset of your nodes and then
test workload execution before rolling the change out cluster-wide.

You can find more detailed information about a possible upgrade and downgrade strategy
in the related Kubernetes Enhancement Proposal (KEP):
[Enable seccomp by default](https://github.com/kubernetes/enhancements/tree/9a124fd29d1f9ddf2ff455c49a630e3181992c25/keps/sig-node/2413-seccomp-by-default#upgrade--downgrade-strategy).

Docs page "Restrict a Container's Syscalls with seccomp", section "Enable the use of `RuntimeDefault` as the default seccomp profile for all workloads". 
Kubernetes {{< skew currentVersion >}} lets you configure the seccomp profile
that applies when the spec for a Pod doesn't define a specific seccomp profile.
However, you still need to enable this defaulting for each node where you would
like to use it.

If you are running a Kubernetes {{< skew currentVersion >}} cluster and want to
enable the feature, either run the kubelet with the `--seccomp-default` command
line flag, or enable it through the [kubelet configuration
file](/docs/tasks/administer-cluster/kubelet-config-file/). To enable the
feature gate in [kind](https://kind.sigs.k8s.io), ensure that `kind` provides
the minimum required Kubernetes version and enables the `SeccompDefault` feature
[in the kind configuration](https://kind.sigs.k8s.io/docs/user/quick-start/#enable-feature-gates-in-your-cluster):

```yaml
kind: Cluster
apiVersion: kind.x-k8s.io/v1alpha4
nodes:
  - role: control-plane

Docs page "Restrict a Container's Syscalls with seccomp", section "Enable the use of `RuntimeDefault` as the default seccomp profile for all workloads". 
```yaml
kind: Cluster
apiVersion: kind.x-k8s.io/v1alpha4
nodes:
  - role: control-plane
    image: kindest/node:v1.28.0@sha256:9f3ff58f19dcf1a0611d11e8ac989fdb30a28f40f236f59f0bea31fb956ccf5c
    kubeadmConfigPatches:
      - |
        kind: JoinConfiguration
        nodeRegistration:
          kubeletExtraArgs:
            seccomp-default: "true"
  - role: worker
    image: kindest/node:v1.28.0@sha256:9f3ff58f19dcf1a0611d11e8ac989fdb30a28f40f236f59f0bea31fb956ccf5c
    kubeadmConfigPatches:
      - |
        kind: JoinConfiguration
        nodeRegistration:
          kubeletExtraArgs:
            seccomp-default: "true"
```

```shell
kubectl run --rm -it --restart=Never --image=alpine alpine -- sh
```

Feature gate APIServerIdentity: alpha from 1.20 to 1.25; beta from 1.26. The gate is active. Assign each API server an ID in a cluster, using a [Lease](/docs/concepts/architecture/leases).

Feature gate APIServerWebhookAuthenticationToken: alpha from 1.37. The gate is active. Enables the `kube-apiserver` to issue short-lived, scoped ServiceAccount tokens

These tokens are bound to a specific ValidatingWebhookConfiguration or
MutatingWebhookConfiguration and are scoped to particular API groups
via attestation claims in the
[TokenRequest](/docs/reference/kubernetes-api/authentication-resources/token-request-v1/) API.

Feature gate APIServingWithRoutine: alpha from 1.30. The gate is active. This feature gate enables an API server performance improvement:

to serve [**watch**](/docs/reference/using-api/api-concepts/#efficient-detection-of-changes)
requests.

Feature gate Accelerators: alpha from 1.6 to 1.10; deprecated from 1.11 to 1.11. The gate was removed. Provided an early form of plugin to enable Nvidia GPU support when using

an alternative.

Feature gate AdmissionWebhookMatchConditions: alpha from 1.27 to 1.27; beta from 1.28 to 1.29; stable from 1.30 to 1.32. The gate was removed. Enable [match conditions](/docs/reference/access-authn-authz/extensible-admission-controllers/#matching-requests-matchconditions)

Feature gate AdvancedAuditing: alpha from 1.7 to 1.7; beta from 1.8 to 1.11; stable from 1.12 to 1.27. The gate was removed. Enable [advanced auditing](/docs/tasks/debug/debug-cluster/audit/#advanced-audit)

Feature gate AnonymousAuthConfigurableEndpoints: alpha from 1.31 to 1.31; beta from 1.32 to 1.33; stable from 1.34. The gate is active. Enable [configurable endpoints for anonymous auth](/docs/reference/access-authn-authz/authentication/#anonymous-authenticator-configuration)

Feature gate AtomicFIFO: beta from 1.36. The gate is active. A client-go implementation of a FIFO queue that uses atomic operations to ensure events that come in
batches, such as those from a ListAndWatch call, are processed in a single chunk. This is in contrast to
the previous implementation which would process these events one by one, potentially causing the internal
cache to become temporarily inconsistent with the API server. This feature gate can be toggled in the
kube-controller-manager and any client-go based controller.

Feature gate AtomicWriteVolumeUserFields: alpha from 1.37. The gate is active. This feature gate exists in the Kubernetes API server and kubelet.

Used from the kube-apiserver, it allows users to set the `user` and `defaultUser` fields

In kubelet, if the `user` or `defaultUser` fields are specified for a volume,
it sets the owner UID of the volume's data files during file creation.

Feature gate CronJobTimeZone: alpha from 1.24 to 1.24; beta from 1.25 to 1.26; stable from 1.27 to 1.28. The gate was removed. Allow the use of the `timeZone` optional field in [CronJobs](/docs/concepts/workloads/controllers/cron-jobs/)

in a ResourceClaim or a ResourceClaimTemplate. Admin access grants access to
in-use devices and may enable additional permissions when making the device

Feature gate DRAConsumableCapacity: alpha from 1.34 to 1.35; beta from 1.36. The gate is active. Enables device sharing across multiple ResourceClaims or requests.

Additionally, if a device supports sharing, its resource (capacity) can be managed through a defined sharing policy.

Feature gate DRAControlPlaneController: alpha from 1.26 to 1.31. The gate was removed. Enables support for resources with custom parameters and a lifecycle
that is independent of a Pod. Allocation of resources is handled
by a resource driver's control plane controller.

Feature gate DRADerivedAttributes: alpha from 1.37. The gate is active. Enables `derivedAttributes` in Dynamic Resource Allocation (DRA), letting
ResourceClaim and ResourceClaimTemplate authors compute virtual device
attributes with per-device CEL expressions, for use in `matchAttribute` and
`distinctAttribute` constraints.

For more information, see
[Derived attributes](/docs/concepts/resource-management/dynamic-resource-allocation/dra-api/#derived-attributes)
in the DRA API Objects documentation.

This allows for thorough device readiness checks and attachment processes before Bind phase.

Feature gate DRADeviceCompatibilityGroups: alpha from 1.37. The gate is active. Enables support for [device compatibility groups](/docs/concepts/resource-management/dynamic-resource-allocation/dra-features/#device-compatibility-groups)
in DRA. Drivers can declare opaque compatibility groups on each
`consumesCounters` entry of a device in a ResourceSlice, and the scheduler

Feature gate DRADeviceTaintRules: alpha from 1.35 to 1.35; beta from 1.36 to 1.37; stable from 1.37. The gate is active. Enables support for

when using dynamic resource allocation to manage devices.

Feature gate DRAExtendedResource: alpha from 1.34 to 1.35; beta from 1.36 to 1.36; stable from 1.37. The gate is active. Enables support for the [Extended Resource allocation by DRA](/docs/concepts/configuration/manage-resources-containers/#extended-resources-allocation-by-dra) feature.
It makes it possible to specify an extended resource name in a DeviceClass.

Feature gate DRAListTypeAttributes: alpha from 1.36. The gate is active. Enables list-type attribute fields (`bools`, `ints`, `strings`, `versions`) for devices
in `ResourceSlice`, allowing a device to advertise multiple values for a single attribute.

values across all selected devices must have a non-empty intersection), and
`distinctAttribute` uses pairwise-disjoint semantics (the sets must share no values).
Scalar attributes remain backward-compatible, treated as singleton sets.

Feature gate DRANodeAllocatableResources: alpha from 1.36. The gate is active. Enables the `kube-scheduler` to incorporate node allocatable resources (such as
CPU, memory, and hugepages) managed by Dynamic Resource Allocation (DRA) into
its standard node resource accounting.

Feature gate DRAPrioritizedList: alpha from 1.33 to 1.33; beta from 1.34 to 1.35; stable from 1.36. The gate is active. Allows specifying a prioritized list of alternative devices that can be allocated to a request in
a claim if the preferred alternative is not available.

Feature gate DRAResourceClaimDeviceStatus: alpha from 1.32 to 1.32; beta from 1.33 to 1.36; stable from 1.37. The gate is active. Enables support the ResourceClaim.status.devices field and for setting this 
status from DRA drivers. It requires the `DynamicResourceAllocation` feature
gate to be enabled.

specific fields within ResourceClaim status objects.

unavailable devices) for a specific driver and optionally a specific pool.

now-corrected fault where Kubernetes ignored exec probe timeouts. See
[readiness probes](/docs/tasks/configure-pod-container/configure-liveness-readiness-startup-probes/#configure-probes).
Feature gate ExpandCSIVolumes: alpha from 1.14 to 1.15; beta from 1.16 to 1.23; stable from 1.24 to 1.26. The gate was removed. Enable the expanding of CSI volumes.

Feature gate ExpandInUsePersistentVolumes: alpha from 1.11 to 1.14; beta from 1.15 to 1.23; stable from 1.24 to 1.26. The gate was removed. Enable expanding in-use PVCs. See
[Resizing an in-use PersistentVolumeClaim](/docs/concepts/storage/persistent-volumes/#resizing-an-in-use-persistentvolumeclaim).

Feature gate ExpandPersistentVolumes: alpha from 1.8 to 1.10; beta from 1.11 to 1.23; stable from 1.24 to 1.26. The gate was removed. Enable the expanding of persistent volumes. See
[Expanding Persistent Volumes Claims](/docs/concepts/storage/persistent-volumes/#expanding-persistent-volumes-claims).

Feature gate ExpandedDNSConfig: alpha from 1.22 to 1.25; beta from 1.26 to 1.27; stable from 1.28 to 1.29. The gate was removed. Enable kubelet and kube-apiserver to allow more DNS
search paths and longer list of DNS search paths. This feature requires container
runtime support(Containerd: v1.5.6 or higher, CRI-O: v1.22 or higher). See
[Expanded DNS Configuration](/docs/concepts/services-networking/dns-pod-service/#expanded-dns-configuration).

Feature gate ExperimentalCriticalPodAnnotation: alpha from 1.5 to 1.12; deprecated from 1.13 to 1.16. The gate was removed. Enable annotating specific pods as *critical*
so that their [scheduling is guaranteed](/docs/tasks/administer-cluster/guaranteed-scheduling-critical-addon-pods/).
This feature is deprecated by Pod Priority and Preemption as of v1.13.

Feature gate ExperimentalHostUserNamespaceDefaulting: beta from 1.5 to 1.27; deprecated from 1.28 to 1.29. The gate was removed. Enabling the defaulting user
namespace to host. This is for containers that are using other host namespaces,
host mounts, or containers that are privileged or using specific non-namespaced
capabilities (e.g. `MKNODE`, `SYS_MODULE` etc.). This should only be enabled
if user namespace remapping is enabled in the Docker daemon.

Feature gate ExternalPolicyForExternalIP: stable from 1.18 to 1.22. The gate was removed. Fix a bug where ExternalTrafficPolicy is not
applied to Service ExternalIPs.

Feature gate ExternalServiceAccountTokenSigner: alpha from 1.32 to 1.33; beta from 1.34 to 1.35; stable from 1.36. The gate is active. Enable setting `--service-account-signing-endpoint` to make the kube-apiserver use [external signer](/docs/reference/access-authn-authz/service-accounts-admin#external-serviceaccount-token-signing-and-key-management) for token signing and token verifying key management.
Feature gate GCERegionalPersistentDisk: beta from 1.10 to 1.12; stable from 1.13 to 1.16. The gate was removed. Enable the regional PD feature on GCE.

Feature gate GRPCContainerProbe: alpha from 1.23 to 1.23; beta from 1.24 to 1.26; stable from 1.27 to 1.28. The gate was removed. Enables the gRPC probe method for {Liveness,Readiness,Startup}Probe.
See [Configure Liveness, Readiness and Startup Probes](/docs/tasks/configure-pod-container/configure-liveness-readiness-startup-probes/#define-a-grpc-liveness-probe).

Feature gate GRPCContainerProbeTLS: alpha from 1.37. The gate is active. Enables TLS support for gRPC container probes. When enabled,
you can add the `mode` field to the `grpc` field in gRPC probes. Setting
`mode: TLS` on a liveness, readiness, or startup probe causes the kubelet
to connect over TLS (with `InsecureSkipVerify`).
See [Configure Liveness, Readiness and Startup Probes](/docs/tasks/configure-pod-container/configure-liveness-readiness-startup-probes/#grpc-probe-tls).

Feature gate GangScheduling: alpha from 1.35 to 1.36. The gate was removed. Enables the GangScheduling plugin in kube-scheduler, which implements "all-or-nothing"
scheduling algorithm. The [Workload API](/docs/concepts/workloads/workload-api/) is used
to express the requirements.

This feature gate was removed in 1.37 and merged together with the `GenericWorkload` feature gate.

Feature gate GenericEphemeralVolume: alpha from 1.19 to 1.20; beta from 1.21 to 1.22; stable from 1.23 to 1.24. The gate was removed. Enables ephemeral, inline volumes that support all features
of normal volumes (can be provided by third-party storage vendors, storage capacity tracking,
restore from snapshot, etc.).
See [Ephemeral Volumes](/docs/concepts/storage/ephemeral-volumes/).

Feature gate GenericWorkload: alpha from 1.35 to 1.36; beta from 1.37. The gate is active. Enables support for the [Workload API](/docs/concepts/workloads/workload-api/) and [PodGroup API](/docs/concepts/workloads/podgroup-api/) to express scheduling requirements at the workload level.

When enabled, Pods can reference a specific PodGroup to influence the way that they are scheduled. Starting in Kubernetes v1.37, this feature gate also encompasses [gang scheduling](/docs/concepts/scheduling-eviction/gang-scheduling/), and [workload-aware preemption](/docs/concepts/scheduling-eviction/

Feature gate GitRepoVolumeDriver: deprecated from 1.33. The gate is active. This controls if the `gitRepo` volume plugin is supported or not.
The `gitRepo` volume plugin is disabled by default starting v1.33 release.
This provides a way for users to enable it.

Feature gate GracefulNodeShutdown: alpha from 1.20 to 1.20; beta from 1.21. The gate is active. Enables support for graceful shutdown in kubelet.
During a system shutdown, kubelet will attempt to detect the shutdown event
and gracefully terminate pods running on the node. See
[Graceful Node Shutdown](/docs/concepts/architecture/nodes/#graceful-node-shutdown)
for more details.

Feature gate GracefulNodeShutdownBasedOnPodPriority: alpha from 1.23 to 1.23; beta from 1.24. The gate is active. Enables the kubelet to check Pod priorities
when shutting down a node gracefully.

Feature gate H2CContainerProbe: alpha from 1.37. The gate is active. Enables HTTP/2 cleartext (h2c) support for HTTP container probes. When enabled,
you can add the `protocol` field to the `httpGet` field in HTTP probes. Setting
`protocol: HTTP2` on a liveness, readiness, or startup probe causes the `kubelet` to
probe over h2c instead of HTTP/1.1.
See [Configure Liveness, Readiness and Startup Probes](/docs/tasks/configure-pod-container/configure-liveness-readiness-startup-probes/#use-h2c-with-http-probes).

Feature gate HPAConfigurableTolerance: alpha from 1.33 to 1.34; beta from 1.35 to 1.36; stable from 1.37. The gate is active. Enables setting a [tolerance threshold](/docs/tasks/run-application/horizontal-pod-autoscale#tolerance)
for HorizontalPodAutoscaler metrics.

Feature gate HPAContainerMetrics: alpha from 1.20 to 1.26; beta from 1.27 to 1.29; stable from 1.30 to 1.31. The gate was removed. Allow {{< glossary_tooltip text="HorizontalPodAutoscalers" term_id="horizontal-pod-autoscaler" >}}
to scale based on metrics from individual containers within target pods.

Feature gate HPAScaleToZero: alpha from 1.16 to 1.36; beta from 1.37. The gate is active. Enables setting `minReplicas` to 0 for `HorizontalPodAutoscaler`
resources when using custom or external metrics.

Feature gate HonorPVReclaimPolicy: alpha from 1.23 to 1.30; beta from 1.31 to 1.32; stable from 1.33 to 1.35. The gate was removed. Honor persistent volume reclaim policy when it is `Delete` irrespective of PV-PVC deletion ordering.
For more details, check the
[PersistentVolume deletion protection finalizer](/docs/concepts/storage/persistent-volumes/#persistentvolume-deletion-protection-finalizer)
documentation.
Feature gate HostnameOverride: alpha from 1.34 to 1.34; beta from 1.35 to 1.36; stable from 1.37. The gate is active. Allows setting any FQDN as the pod's hostname.

Feature gate HugePageStorageMediumSize: alpha from 1.18 to 1.18; beta from 1.19 to 1.21; stable from 1.22 to 1.24. The gate was removed. Enable support for multiple sizes pre-allocated
[huge pages](/docs/tasks/manage-hugepages/scheduling-hugepages/).

Feature gate HugePages: alpha from 1.8 to 1.9; beta from 1.10 to 1.13; stable from 1.14 to 1.16. The gate was removed. Enable the allocation and consumption of pre-allocated
[huge pages](/docs/tasks/manage-hugepages/scheduling-hugepages/).

Feature gate HugepageAwareEviction: beta from 1.37. The gate is active. Subtracts hugepage capacity from `memory.available` so the kubelet's eviction
signal reflects actual regular-memory availability. Without this gate, hugepage
reservations inflate `AvailableBytes`, delaying eviction and causing OOM kills
on nodes with hugepages configured.

Feature gate HyperVContainer: alpha from 1.10 to 1.19; deprecated from 1.20 to 1.20. The gate was removed. Enable
[Hyper-V isolation](https://docs.microsoft.com/en-us/virtualization/windowscontainers/manage-containers/hyperv-container)
for Windows containers.
Feature gate IPTablesOwnershipCleanup: alpha from 1.25 to 1.26; beta from 1.27 to 1.27; stable from 1.28 to 1.29. The gate was removed. This causes kubelet to no longer create legacy iptables rules.

Feature gate IPv6DualStack: alpha from 1.15 to 1.20; beta from 1.21 to 1.22; stable from 1.23 to 1.24. The gate was removed. Enable [dual stack](/docs/concepts/services-networking/dual-stack/)
support for IPv6.

Feature gate IdentifyPodOS: alpha from 1.23 to 1.23; beta from 1.24 to 1.24; stable from 1.25 to 1.26. The gate was removed. Allows the Pod OS field to be specified. This helps in identifying
the OS of the pod authoritatively during the API server admission time.

Feature gate ImageMaximumGCAge: alpha from 1.29 to 1.29; beta from 1.30 to 1.34; stable from 1.35. The gate is active. Enables the kubelet configuration field `imageMaximumGCAge`, allowing an administrator to specify the age after which an image will be garbage collected.

Feature gate ImageVolume: alpha from 1.31 to 1.32; beta from 1.33 to 1.34; beta from 1.35 to 1.35; stable from 1.36. The gate is active. Allow using the [`image`](/docs/concepts/storage/volumes/) volume source in a Pod.
This volume source lets you mount a container image as a read-only volume.

Feature gate ImageVolumeWithDigest: alpha from 1.35. The gate is active. For each [`image` volume](/docs/concepts/storage/volumes#image) in a Pod,
image digest as part of the pod's status.

Feature gate ImmutableEphemeralVolumes: alpha from 1.18 to 1.18; beta from 1.19 to 1.20; stable from 1.21 to 1.24. The gate was removed. Allows for marking individual Secrets and ConfigMaps as
immutable for better safety and performance.
Feature gate InOrderInformers: alpha from 1.33 to 1.33; beta from 1.34. The gate is active. Force the informers to deliver watch stream events in order instead of out of order.

Feature gate InPlacePodLevelResourcesVerticalScaling: alpha from 1.35 to 1.35; beta from 1.36. The gate is active. Enables the in-place vertical scaling of resources for a Pod (For example, changing a
running Pod's pod-level CPU or memory requests/limits without needing to restart
it). For details, see the documentation on [In-place Pod-level Resources Vertical Scaling](/docs/tasks/configure-pod-container/resize-pod-resources/).
Feature gate InPlacePodVerticalScaling: alpha from 1.27 to 1.32; beta from 1.33 to 1.34; stable from 1.35. The gate is active. Enables in-place Pod vertical scaling.

Feature gate InPlacePodVerticalScalingAllocatedStatus: alpha from 1.32 to 1.32; deprecated from 1.33. The gate is active. Enables the `allocatedResources` field in the container status.
This feature requires the `InPlacePodVerticalScaling` gate be enabled as well.

Feature gate InPlacePodVerticalScalingExclusiveCPUs: alpha from 1.32. The gate is active. Enable resource resizing for containers in Guaranteed pods with integer CPU requests.
It applies only in nodes with `InPlacePodVerticalScaling` and `CPUManager` features enabled,
and the CPUManager policy set to `static`.

Feature gate InPlacePodVerticalScalingExclusiveMemory: alpha from 1.34. The gate is active. Allow resource resize for containers in Guaranteed Pods when the memory manager policy is set to `"Static"`.
Applies only to nodes with `InPlacePodVerticalScaling` and memory manager features enabled.
Feature gate InPlacePodVerticalScalingMemoryBackedVolumes: alpha from 1.37. The gate is active. Enables in-place vertical scaling for memory-backed `emptyDir` volume size limits.

Feature gate InPlacePodVerticalScalingSchedulerPreemption: alpha from 1.37. The gate is active. Enables scheduler preemption of lower-priority pods to fulfill deferred
in-place pod resize requests.

Feature gate InTreePluginAWSUnregister: alpha from 1.21 to 1.30. The gate was removed. Stops registering the aws-ebs in-tree plugin in kubelet
and volume controllers.

Feature gate InTreePluginAzureDiskUnregister: alpha from 1.21 to 1.30. The gate was removed. Stops registering the azuredisk in-tree plugin in kubelet
and volume controllers.

Feature gate InTreePluginAzureFileUnregister: alpha from 1.21 to 1.30. The gate was removed. Stops registering the azurefile in-tree plugin in kubelet
and volume controllers.

Feature gate InTreePluginGCEUnregister: alpha from 1.21 to 1.30. The gate was removed. Stops registering the gce-pd in-tree plugin in kubelet
and volume controllers.

Feature gate InTreePluginOpenStackUnregister: alpha from 1.21 to 1.30. The gate was removed. Stops registering the OpenStack cinder in-tree plugin in kubelet
and volume controllers.

Feature gate InTreePluginPortworxUnregister: alpha from 1.23 to 1.35. The gate was removed. Stops registering the Portworx in-tree plugin in kubelet
and volume controllers.
Feature gate InTreePluginRBDUnregister: alpha from 1.23 to 1.27; deprecated from 1.28 to 1.30. The gate was removed. Stops registering the RBD in-tree plugin within kubelet and volume controllers.

Feature gate InTreePluginvSphereUnregister: alpha from 1.21 to 1.30. The gate was removed. Stops registering the vSphere in-tree plugin in kubelet
and volume controllers.

Feature gate IndexedJob: alpha from 1.21 to 1.21; beta from 1.22 to 1.23; stable from 1.24 to 1.25. The gate was removed. Allows the [Job](/docs/concepts/workloads/controllers/job/)
controller to manage Pod completions per completion index.

Feature gate InformerResourceVersion: alpha from 1.30 to 1.34; stable from 1.35. The gate is active. Allow clients to use the `LastSyncResourceVersion()` call on informers, enabling
them to perform actions based on the current resource version. When disabled,
`LastSyncResourceVersion()` succeeds but returns an empty string. Used by
kube-controller-manager for StorageVersionMigration.

Feature gate IngressClassNamespacedParams: alpha from 1.21 to 1.21; beta from 1.22 to 1.22; stable from 1.23 to 1.24. The gate was removed. Allow namespace-scoped parameters reference in
`IngressClass` resource. This feature adds two fields - `Scope` and `Namespace`
to `IngressClass.spec.parameters`.

Feature gate Initializers: alpha from 1.7 to 1.13; deprecated from 1.14 to 1.14. The gate was removed. Allow asynchronous coordination of object creation using the
Initializers admission plugin.

Feature gate JobBackoffLimitPerIndex: alpha from 1.28 to 1.28; beta from 1.29 to 1.32; stable from 1.33. The gate is active. Allows specifying the maximal number of pod
retries per index in Indexed jobs.
Feature gate JobManagedBy: alpha from 1.30 to 1.31; beta from 1.32 to 1.34; stable from 1.35. The gate is active. Allows to delegate reconciliation of a Job object to an external controller.

Feature gate JobMutableNodeSchedulingDirectives: beta from 1.23 to 1.26; stable from 1.27 to 1.28. The gate was removed. Allows updating node scheduling directives in
the pod template of [Job](/docs/concepts/workloads/controllers/job).

Feature gate JobPodFailurePolicy: alpha from 1.25 to 1.25; beta from 1.26 to 1.30; stable from 1.31 to 1.32. The gate was removed. Allow users to specify handling of pod failures based on container
exit codes and pod conditions.

Feature gate JobPodReplacementPolicy: alpha from 1.28 to 1.28; beta from 1.29 to 1.33; stable from 1.34. The gate is active. Allows you to specify pod replacement for terminating pods in a [Job](/docs/concepts/workloads/controllers/job)

Feature gate JobReadyPods: alpha from 1.23 to 1.23; beta from 1.24 to 1.28; stable from 1.29 to 1.30. The gate was removed. Enables tracking the number of Pods that have a `Ready`
[condition](/docs/concepts/workloads/pods/pod-lifecycle/#pod-conditions).
The count of `Ready` pods is recorded in the
[status](/docs/reference/kubernetes-api/workload-resources/job-v1/#JobStatus)
of a [Job](/docs/concepts/workloads/controllers/job) status.

Feature gate JobSuccessPolicy: alpha from 1.30 to 1.30; beta from 1.31 to 1.32; stable from 1.33. The gate is active. Allow users to specify when a Job can be declared as succeeded based on the set of succeeded pods.

Feature gate JobTrackingWithFinalizers: alpha from 1.22 to 1.22; beta from 1.23 to 1.24; beta from 1.25 to 1.25; stable from 1.26 to 1.28. The gate was removed. Enables tracking [Job](/docs/concepts/workloads/controllers/job)
completions without relying on Pods remaining in the cluster indefinitely.
The Job controller uses Pod finalizers and a field in the Job status to keep
track of the finished Pods to count towards completion.

Feature gate KMSv1: deprecated from 1.28 to 1.28; deprecated from 1.29. The gate is active. Enables KMS v1 API for encryption at rest. See
[Using a KMS Provider for data encryption](/docs/tasks/administer-cluster/kms-provider)
for more details.

Feature gate KMSv2: alpha from 1.25 to 1.26; beta from 1.27 to 1.28; stable from 1.29 to 1.31. The gate was removed. Enables KMS v2 API for encryption at rest. See
[Using a KMS Provider for data encryption](/docs/tasks/administer-cluster/kms-provider)
for more details.

Feature gate KMSv2KDF: beta from 1.28 to 1.28; stable from 1.29 to 1.31. The gate was removed. Enables KMS v2 to generate single use data encryption keys.
See [Using a KMS Provider for data encryption](/docs/tasks/administer-cluster/kms-provider) for more details.
If the `KMSv2` feature gate is not enabled in your cluster, the value of the `KMSv2KDF` feature gate has no effect.

Feature gate KubeProxyDrainingTerminatingNodes: alpha from 1.28 to 1.30; beta from 1.30 to 1.30; stable from 1.31 to 1.32. The gate was removed. Implement connection draining for
terminating nodes for `externalTrafficPolicy: Cluster` services.
Feature gate KubeProxyIPVS: deprecated from 1.37. The gate is active. Enable support for the deprecated [`ipvs` proxy mode](/docs/reference/networking/virtual-ips/#proxy-mode-ipvs) in kube-proxy.

Feature gate KubeProxyNFTablesLocalhostNodePorts: alpha from 1.37. The gate is active. Enables localhost NodePort Service proxying with the nftables mode of
kube-proxy.

Feature gate KubeletCgroupDriverFromCRI: alpha from 1.28 to 1.30; beta from 1.31; stable from 1.34. The gate is active. Enable detection of the kubelet cgroup driver
configuration option from the {{<glossary_tooltip term_id="cri" text="CRI">}}.
This feature gate is now on for all clusters. However, it only works on nodes
where there is a CRI container runtime that supports the `RuntimeConfig`
CRI call. If the CRI supports this feature, the kubelet ignores the
`cgroupDriver` configuration setting (or deprecated `--cgroup-driver` command
line argument). If the container runtime
doesn't support it, the kubelet falls

Feature gate KubeletConfigFile: alpha from 1.8 to 1.9; deprecated from 1.10 to 1.10. The gate was removed. Enable loading kubelet configuration from
a file specified using a config file.
See [setting kubelet parameters via a config file](/docs/tasks/administer-cluster/kubelet-config-file/)
for more details.

Feature gate KubeletCrashLoopBackOffMax: alpha from 1.32 to 1.34; beta from 1.35. The gate is active. Enables support for configurable per-node backoff maximums for restarting
containers in the `CrashLoopBackOff` state.
For more details, check the `crashLoopBackOff.maxContainerRestartPeriod` field in the
[kubelet config file](/docs/reference/config-api/kubelet-config.v1beta1/).

Feature gate KubeletCredentialProviders: alpha from 1.20 to 1.23; beta from 1.24 to 1.25; stable from 1.26 to 1.28. The gate was removed. Enable kubelet exec credential providers for
image pull credentials.

Feature gate KubeletEnsureSecretPulledImages: alpha from 1.33 to 1.34; beta from 1.35. The gate is active. Ensure that pods requesting an image are authorized to access the image
with the provided credentials when the image is already present on the node.
See [Ensure Image Pull Credential Verification](/docs/concepts/containers/images#ensureimagepullcredentialverification).

Feature gate KubeletFineGrainedAuthz: alpha from 1.32 to 1.32; beta from 1.33 to 1.35; stable from 1.36. The gate is active. Enable [fine-grained authorization](/docs/reference/access-authn-authz/kubelet-authn-authz/#fine-grained-authorization) 
for the kubelet's HTTP(s) API.

Feature gate KubeletInUserNamespace: alpha from 1.22 to 1.36; beta from 1.37. The gate is active. Enables support for running kubelet in a
{{<glossary_tooltip text="user namespace" term_id="userns">}}.
 See [Running Kubernetes Node Components as a Non-root User](/docs/tasks/administer-cluster/kubelet-in-userns/).

Feature gate KubeletPSI: alpha from 1.33 to 1.33; beta from 1.34 to 1.35; stable from 1.36. The gate is active. Enable kubelet to surface Pressure Stall Information (PSI) metrics in the Summary API and Prometheus metrics.

Feature gate KubeletPluginsWatcher: alpha from 1.11 to 1.11; beta from 1.12 to 1.12; stable from 1.13 to 1.16. The gate was removed. Enable probe-based plugin watcher utility to enable kubelet
to discover plugins such as [CSI volume drivers](/docs/concepts/storage/volumes/#csi).

Feature gate KubeletPodResources: alpha from 1.13 to 1.14; beta from 1.15 to 1.27; stable from 1.28 to 1.29. The gate was removed. Enable the kubelet's pod resources gRPC endpoint. See
[Support Device Monitoring](https://github.com/kubernetes/enhancements/blob/master/keps/sig-node/606-compute-device-assignment/README.md)
for more details.

Feature gate KubeletPodResourcesDynamicResources: alpha from 1.27 to 1.33; beta from 1.34 to 1.35; stable from 1.36. The gate is active. Extend the kubelet's
[pod resources monitoring gRPC API](/docs/concepts/extend-kubernetes/compute-storage-net/device-plugins/)
endpoints List and Get to include resources allocated in ResourceClaims
via [Dynamic Resource Allocation](/docs/concepts/resource-management/dynamic-resource-allocation/).

Below is an example of GPU metrics to show how this API is consumed by
[NVIDIA dcgm-exporter](https://github.com/NVIDIA/dcgm-exporter) to collect per pod GPU metrics allocated by
[NVIDIA DRA driver](h

Feature gate KubeletPodResourcesGet: alpha from 1.27 to 1.33; beta from 1.34 to 1.35; stable from 1.36. The gate is active. Enable the `Get` gRPC endpoint on kubelet's for Pod resources.
This API augments the [resource allocation reporting](/docs/concepts/extend-kubernetes/compute-storage-net/device-plugins/#monitoring-device-plugin-resources).

Feature gate KubeletPodResourcesGetAllocatable: alpha from 1.21 to 1.22; beta from 1.23 to 1.27; stable from 1.28 to 1.29. The gate was removed. Enable the kubelet's pod resources
`GetAllocatableResources` functionality. This API augments the
[resource allocation reporting](/docs/concepts/extend-kubernetes/compute-storage-net/device-plugins/#monitoring-device-plugin-resources)

Feature gate KubeletSeparateDiskGC: alpha from 1.29 to 1.30; beta from 1.31. The gate is active. The split image filesystem feature enables kubelet to perform garbage collection
of images (read-only layers) and/or containers (writeable layers) deployed on
separate filesystems.

Feature gate KubeletServiceAccountTokenForCredentialProviders: alpha from 1.33 to 1.33; beta from 1.34. The gate is active. Enable kubelet to send the service account token bound to the pod for which the image is being pulled to the credential provider plugin.

Feature gate KubeletTracing: alpha from 1.25 to 1.26; beta from 1.27 to 1.33; stable from 1.34. The gate is active. Add support for distributed tracing in the kubelet.
When enabled, kubelet CRI interface and authenticated http servers are instrumented to generate
OpenTelemetry trace spans.
See [Traces for Kubernetes System Components](/docs/concepts/cluster-administration/system-traces) for more details.

Feature gate LegacyNodeRoleBehavior: alpha from 1.16 to 1.18; beta from 1.19 to 1.20; stable from 1.21 to 1.22. The gate was removed. When disabled, legacy behavior in service load balancers and
node disruption will ignore the `node-role.kubernetes.io/master` label in favor of the
feature-specific labels provided by `NodeDisruptionExclusion` and `ServiceNodeExclusion`.

Feature gate LegacyServiceAccountTokenCleanUp: alpha from 1.28 to 1.28; beta from 1.29 to 1.29; stable from 1.30 to 1.31. The gate was removed. Enable cleaning up Secret-based
[service account tokens](/docs/concepts/security/service-accounts/#get-a-token)
when they are not used in a specified time (default to be one year).

Feature gate LegacyServiceAccountTokenNoAutoGeneration: beta from 1.24 to 1.25; stable from 1.26 to 1.28. The gate was removed. Stop auto-generation of Secret-based
[service account tokens](/docs/concepts/security/service-accounts/#get-a-token).

Feature gate LegacyServiceAccountTokenTracking: alpha from 1.26 to 1.26; beta from 1.27 to 1.27; stable from 1.28 to 1.29. The gate was removed. Track usage of Secret-based
[service account tokens](/docs/concepts/security/service-accounts/#get-a-token).

Feature gate ListFromCacheSnapshot: alpha from 1.33 to 1.33; beta from 1.34. The gate is active. Enables the API server to generate snapshots for the watch cache store and using them to serve LIST requests.

Feature gate LoadBalancerIPMode: alpha from 1.29 to 1.30; beta from 1.30 to 1.31; stable from 1.32 to 1.34. The gate was removed. Allows setting `ipMode` for Services where `type` is set to `LoadBalancer`.
See [Specifying IPMode of load balancer status](/docs/concepts/services-networking/service/#load-balancer-ip-mode)
for more information.

Feature gate LocalStorageCapacityIsolation: alpha from 1.7 to 1.9; beta from 1.10 to 1.24; stable from 1.25 to 1.26. The gate was removed. Enable the consumption of
[local ephemeral storage](/docs/concepts/configuration/manage-resources-containers/)
and also the `sizeLimit` property of an
[emptyDir volume](/docs/concepts/storage/volumes/#emptydir).

Feature gate LocalStorageCapacityIsolationFSQuotaMonitoring: alpha from 1.15 to 1.30; beta from 1.31. The gate is active. When `LocalStorageCapacityIsolation` 
is enabled for 
[local ephemeral storage](/docs/concepts/configuration/manage-resources-containers/), 
the backing filesystem for [emptyDir volumes](/docs/concepts/storage/volumes/#emptydir) supports project quotas,
and `UserNamespacesSupport` is enabled, 
project quotas are used to monitor `emptyDir` volume storage consumption rather than using filesystem walk, ensuring better performance and accuracy.

Feature gate LogarithmicScaleDown: alpha from 1.21 to 1.21; beta from 1.22 to 1.30; stable from 1.31. The gate is active. Enable semi-random selection of pods to evict on controller scaledown
based on logarithmic bucketing of pod timestamps.
Feature gate LoggingAlphaOptions: alpha from 1.24. The gate is active. Allow fine-tuning of experimental, alpha-quality logging options.
Feature gate LoggingBetaOptions: beta from 1.24. The gate is active. Allow fine-tuning of experimental, beta-quality logging options.

Feature gate ManifestBasedAdmissionControlConfig: alpha from 1.36 to 1.36; beta from 1.37. The gate is active. Enable loading admission webhooks and CEL-based admission policies from
static manifest files on disk via the `staticManifestsDir` field in
`AdmissionConfiguration`. These policies are active from API server startup,
survive etcd unavailability, and can protect API-based admission resources
from modification.

Feature gate MatchLabelKeysInPodAffinity: alpha from 1.29 to 1.30; beta from 1.31 to 1.32; stable from 1.33. The gate is active. Enable the `matchLabelKeys` and `mismatchLabelKeys` fields for
[pod (anti)affinity](/docs/concepts/scheduling-eviction/assign-pod-node/).

Feature gate MatchLabelKeysInPodTopologySpread: alpha from 1.25 to 1.26; beta from 1.27. The gate is active. Enable the `matchLabelKeys` field for
[Pod topology spread constraints](/docs/concepts/scheduling-eviction/topology-spread-constraints/).

Feature gate MatchLabelKeysInPodTopologySpreadSelectorMerge: beta from 1.34. The gate is active. Enable merging of selectors built from `matchLabelKeys` into `labelSelector` of 
[Pod topology spread constraints](/docs/concepts/scheduling-eviction/topology-spread-constraints/).
This feature gate can be enabled when `matchLabelKeys` feature is enabled with the `MatchLabelKeysInPodTopologySpread` feature flag.

Feature gate MaxUnavailableStatefulSet: alpha from 1.24 to 1.34; beta from 1.35.0 to 1.35.3; beta from 1.35.4 to 1.36; beta from 1.37. The gate is active. Enables setting the `maxUnavailable` field for the
[rolling update strategy](/docs/concepts/workloads/controllers/statefulset/#rolling-updates)
of a StatefulSet. The field specifies the maximum number of Pods
that can be unavailable during the update.

Feature gate MemoryManager: alpha from 1.21 to 1.21; beta from 1.22 to 1.31; stable from 1.32. The gate is active. Allows setting memory affinity for a container based on
NUMA topology.

Feature gate MemoryQoS: alpha from 1.22 to 1.36; beta from 1.37. The gate is active. Enable memory protection and usage throttling for Pods and containers using
the cgroup v2 memory controller. When `memoryThrottlingFactor` is set, the
`kubelet` sets `memory.high` for throttling on Burstable and BestEffort
containers. The `kubelet` optionally sets `memory.min` and `memory.low` for
tiered memory protection when `memoryReservationPolicy` is set to
`TieredReservation`. Feature requires both - feature gate enablement and
`kubelet` configuration setting.

Feature gate MinDomainsInPodTopologySpread: alpha from 1.24 to 1.24; beta from 1.25 to 1.26; beta from 1.27 to 1.29; stable from 1.30 to 1.31. The gate was removed. Enable `minDomains` in
[Pod topology spread constraints](/docs/concepts/scheduling-eviction/topology-spread-constraints/).

Feature gate MinimizeIPTablesRestore: alpha from 1.26 to 1.26; beta from 1.27 to 1.27; stable from 1.28 to 1.29. The gate was removed. Enables new performance improvement logics
in the kube-proxy iptables mode.

Feature gate MixedProtocolLBService: alpha from 1.20 to 1.23; beta from 1.24 to 1.25; stable from 1.26 to 1.27. The gate was removed. Enable using different protocols in the same `LoadBalancer` type
Service instance.
Feature gate MountContainers: alpha from 1.9 to 1.16; deprecated from 1.17 to 1.17. The gate was removed. Enable using utility containers on host as the volume mounter.

Feature gate MountPropagation: alpha from 1.8 to 1.9; beta from 1.10 to 1.11; stable from 1.12 to 1.14. The gate was removed. Enable sharing volume mounted by one container to other containers or pods.
For more details, please see [mount propagation](/docs/concepts/storage/volumes/#mount-propagation).
Feature gate MultiCIDRRangeAllocator: alpha from 1.25 to 1.28. The gate was removed. Enables the MultiCIDR range allocator.

Feature gate MultiCIDRServiceAllocator: alpha from 1.27 to 1.30; beta from 1.31 to 1.32; stable from 1.33. The gate is active. Track IP address allocations for Service cluster IPs using IPAddress objects.

Feature gate MutableCSINodeAllocatableCount: alpha from 1.33 to 1.33; beta from 1.34 to 1.34; beta from 1.35 to 1.35; stable from 1.36. The gate is active. Make the `.spec.drivers[*].allocatable.count` field of a CSINode mutable.
Also, enable a CSIDriver field, `nodeAllocatableUpdatePeriodSeconds`.

This allows periodic updates to a node's reported allocatable volume capacity,
preventing stateful pods from becoming stuck due to outdated information
that the kube-scheduler would otherwise rely upon.

Feature gate MutablePVNodeAffinity: alpha from 1.35. The gate is active. Allow update to the `.spec.nodeAffinity` field of a PersistentVolume.
See [Updates to node affinity](/docs/concepts/storage/persistent-volumes/#updates-to-node-affinity) for more details.

Feature gate MutablePodResourcesForSuspendedJobs: alpha from 1.35 to 1.35; beta from 1.36. The gate is active. Enable the ability to patch pod templates for suspended Jobs, in order to change requests or limits for infrastructure resources.

Feature gate MutableSchedulingDirectivesForSuspendedJobs: alpha from 1.35 to 1.35; beta from 1.36. The gate is active. Enable the ability to patch pod templates for suspended Jobs, in order to change the pod scheduling directives.

Feature gate MutatingAdmissionPolicy: alpha from 1.30 to 1.33; beta from 1.34 to 1.35; stable from 1.36. The gate is active. Enable [MutatingAdmissionPolicy](/docs/reference/access-authn-authz/mutating-admission-policy/) support, which allows
[CEL](/docs/reference/using-api/cel/) mutations to
be applied during admission control.

For Kubernetes v1.30 and v1.31, this feature gate existed but had no effect.

Feature gate NFTablesProxyMode: alpha from 1.29 to 1.30; beta from 1.31 to 1.32; stable from 1.33. The gate is active. Allow running kube-proxy in [nftables mode](/docs/reference/networking/virtual-ips/#proxy-mode-nftables).

Feature gate NamespaceDefaultLabelName: beta from 1.21 to 1.21; stable from 1.22 to 1.23. The gate was removed. Configure the API Server to set an immutable
{{< glossary_tooltip text="label" term_id="label" >}} `kubernetes.io/metadata.name`
on all namespaces, containing the namespace name.

Feature gate NativeHistograms: alpha from 1.36 to 1.36; beta from 1.37. The gate is active. Enables Kubernetes components to expose metrics in Prometheus Native Histogram format for improved efficiency and finer bucket resolution.
See [Native Histograms](/docs/reference/instrumentation/native-histograms/) for more information.

Feature gate NetworkPolicyEndPort: alpha from 1.21 to 1.21; beta from 1.22 to 1.24; stable from 1.25 to 1.26. The gate was removed. Allows you to define ports in a
[NetworkPolicy](/docs/concepts/services-networking/network-policies/)
rule as a range of port numbers.
Feature gate NetworkPolicyStatus: alpha from 1.24 to 1.27. The gate was removed. Enable the `status` subresource for NetworkPolicy objects.

Feature gate NewVolumeManagerReconstruction: alpha from 1.25 to 1.26; beta from 1.27 to 1.29; stable from 1.30 to 1.31. The gate was removed. Enables improved discovery of mounted volumes during kubelet
startup. Since the associated code had been significantly refactored, Kubernetes versions 1.25 to 1.29
allowed you to opt-out in case the kubelet got stuck at the startup, or did not unmount volumes
from terminated Pods.

This refactoring was behind the `SELinuxMountReadWriteOncePod`  feature gate in Kubernetes
releases 1.25 and 1.26.

Feature gate NodeDeclaredFeatures: alpha from 1.35 to 1.35; beta from 1.36 to 1.36; stable from 1.37. The gate is active. Enables Nodes to report supported features via their `.status`. This enables the
scheduler and admission controller to prevent operations on nodes lacking features
required by the Pod. See [Node Declared Features](/docs/concepts/scheduling-eviction/node-declared-features/).

Feature gate NodeDisruptionExclusion: alpha from 1.16 to 1.18; beta from 1.19 to 1.20; stable from 1.21 to 1.22. The gate was removed. Enable use of the Node label `node.kubernetes.io/exclude-disruption`
which prevents nodes from being evacuated during zone failures.

Feature gate NodeInclusionPolicyInPodTopologySpread: alpha from 1.25 to 1.25; beta from 1.26 to 1.32; stable from 1.33. The gate is active. Enable using `nodeAffinityPolicy` and `nodeTaintsPolicy` in
[Pod topology spread constraints](/docs/concepts/scheduling-eviction/topology-spread-constraints/)
when calculating pod topology spread skew.

Feature gate NodeLease: alpha from 1.12 to 1.13; beta from 1.14 to 1.16; stable from 1.17 to 1.23. The gate was removed. Enable the new Lease API to report node heartbeats, which could be used as a node health signal.

Feature gate NodeLifecycleConditions: alpha from 1.37. The gate is active. Enables well-known Node conditions that report drain, maintenance, and
[Graceful Node Shutdown](/docs/concepts/cluster-administration/node-shutdown/)
lifecycle state. See
[Node lifecycle conditions](/docs/reference/node/node-lifecycle-conditions/).
Feature gate NodeLogQuery: alpha from 1.27 to 1.29; beta from 1.30 to 1.35; stable from 1.36. The gate is active. Enables querying logs of node services using the `/logs` endpoint.

Feature gate NodeOutOfServiceVolumeDetach: alpha from 1.24 to 1.25; beta from 1.26 to 1.27; stable from 1.28 to 1.31. The gate was removed. When a Node is marked out-of-service using the
`node.kubernetes.io/out-of-service` taint, Pods on the node will be forcefully deleted
 if they can not tolerate this taint, and the volume detach operations for Pods terminating
 on the node will happen immediately. The deleted Pods can recover quickly on different nodes.

Feature gate NodeSwap: alpha from 1.22 to 1.27; beta from 1.28 to 1.29; beta from 1.30 to 1.33; stable from 1.34. The gate is active. Enable the kubelet to allocate swap memory for Kubernetes workloads on a node.
Must be used with `KubeletConfiguration.failSwapOn` set to false.
For more details, please see [swap memory](/docs/concepts/architecture/nodes/#swap-memory)

Feature gate NominatedNodeNameForExpectation: alpha from 1.34 to 1.34; beta from 1.35. The gate is active. When enabled, kube-scheduler uses `.status.nominatedNodeName` to express where a
Pod is going to be bound. The `.status.nominatedNodeName` field is set when kube-scheduler
triggers preemption of pods, or anticipates that WaitOnPermit or PreBinding phase will take
relatively long.
Other components may read and use `.status.nominatedNodeName`, but should not set it.

When disabled, kube-scheduler will only set `.status.nominatedNodeName` before triggering preemption.
Feature gate NonPreemptingPriority: alpha from 1.15 to 1.18; beta from 1.19 to 1.23; stable from 1.24 to 1.25. The gate was removed. Enable `preemptionPolicy` field for PriorityClass and Pod.

Feature gate OpenAPIEnums: alpha from 1.23 to 1.23; beta from 1.24. The gate is active. Enables populating "enum" fields of OpenAPI schemas in the
spec returned from the API server.
Feature gate OpenAPIV3: alpha from 1.23 to 1.23; beta from 1.24 to 1.26; stable from 1.27 to 1.28. The gate was removed. Enables the API server to publish OpenAPI v3.
Feature gate OpportunisticBatching: beta from 1.35. The gate is active. Enable reusing of scheduling results from the previous scheduling cycle for equivalent pods.

Feature gate OrderedNamespaceDeletion: beta from 1.30 to 1.32; beta from 1.33 to 1.33; stable from 1.34. The gate is active. While deleting namespace, the pods resources is going to be deleted before the rest of resources.

Feature gate PDBUnhealthyPodEvictionPolicy: alpha from 1.26 to 1.26; beta from 1.27 to 1.30; stable from 1.31 to 1.32. The gate was removed. Enables the `unhealthyPodEvictionPolicy` field of a `PodDisruptionBudget`. This specifies
when unhealthy pods should be considered for eviction. Please see [Unhealthy Pod Eviction Policy](/docs/tasks/run-application/configure-pdb/#unhealthy-pod-eviction-policy)
for more details.

Feature gate PVCProtection: alpha from 1.9 to 1.9; deprecated from 1.10 to 1.10. The gate was removed. Enable the prevention of a PersistentVolumeClaim (PVC) from
being deleted when it is still used by any Pod.

Feature gate PersistentLocalVolumes: alpha from 1.7 to 1.9; beta from 1.10 to 1.13; stable from 1.14 to 1.16. The gate was removed. Enable the usage of `local` volume type in Pods.
Pod affinity has to be specified if requesting a `local` volume.

Feature gate PersistentVolumeClaimUnusedSinceTime: alpha from 1.36 to 1.36; beta from 1.37. The gate is active. When enabled, the PVC protection controller adds an `Unused` condition to
PersistentVolumeClaims that tracks whether the PVC is currently referenced by
any non-terminal Pod. The condition's `lastTransitionTime` records when the PVC
last transitioned between being in use and being unused.

Feature gate PersistentVolumeLastPhaseTransitionTime: alpha from 1.28 to 1.28; beta from 1.29 to 1.30; stable from 1.31 to 1.32. The gate was removed. Adds a new field to PersistentVolume
which holds a timestamp of when the volume last transitioned its phase.

Feature gate PodAffinityNamespaceSelector: alpha from 1.21 to 1.21; beta from 1.22 to 1.23; stable from 1.24 to 1.25. The gate was removed. Enable the
[Pod Affinity Namespace Selector](/docs/concepts/scheduling-eviction/assign-pod-node/#namespace-selector)
and [CrossNamespacePodAffinity](/docs/concepts/policy/resource-quotas/#cross-namespace-pod-affinity-quota)
quota scope features.

Feature gate PodAndContainerStatsFromCRI: alpha from 1.23 to 1.36; beta from 1.37. The gate is active. Configure the kubelet to gather container and pod stats from the CRI container runtime rather than gathering them from cAdvisor.
As of 1.26, this also includes gathering metrics from CRI and emitting them over `/metrics/cadvisor` (rather than having cAdvisor emit them directly).

Feature gate PodCertificateRequest: alpha from 1.34 to 1.34; beta from 1.35 to 1.36; stable from 1.37. The gate is active. Enable PodCertificateRequest objects and podCertificate projected volume
sources.

Feature gate PodDeletionCost: alpha from 1.21 to 1.21; beta from 1.22. The gate is active. Enable the [Pod Deletion Cost](/docs/concepts/workloads/controllers/replicaset/#pod-deletion-cost)
 feature which allows users to influence ReplicaSet downscaling order.

Feature gate PodDisruptionBudget: alpha from 1.3 to 1.4; beta from 1.5 to 1.20; stable from 1.21 to 1.25. The gate was removed. Enable the [PodDisruptionBudget](/docs/tasks/run-application/configure-pdb/) feature.

Feature gate PodDisruptionConditions: alpha from 1.25 to 1.25; beta from 1.26 to 1.30; stable from 1.31 to 1.33. The gate was removed. Enabled support for appending a dedicated pod condition indicating that the pod is being deleted due to a disruption.

Feature gate PodGroupPreemptionPolicy: alpha from 1.37. The gate is active. Enables the support for `PreemptionPolicy` field in [PodGroup API](/docs/concepts/workloads/podgroup-api/) and [Workload API](/docs/concepts/workloads/workload-api/).

When enabled, if a PodGroup has `PreemptionPolicy: Never` it will not perform workload aware preemption.

Feature gate PodHasNetworkCondition: alpha from 1.25 to 1.27. The gate was removed. Enable the kubelet to mark the [PodHasNetwork](/docs/concepts/workloads/pods/pod-lifecycle/#pod-has-network)
condition on pods. This was renamed to `PodReadyToStartContainersCondition` in 1.28.

Feature gate PodHostIPs: alpha from 1.28 to 1.28; beta from 1.29 to 1.30; stable from 1.30 to 1.31. The gate was removed. Enable the `status.hostIPs` field for pods and the {{< glossary_tooltip term_id="downward-api" text="downward API" >}}.
The field lets you expose host IP addresses to workloads.

Feature gate PodIndexLabel: beta from 1.28 to 1.31; stable from 1.32. The gate is active. Enables the Job controller and StatefulSet controller to add the pod index as a label when creating new pods. See [Job completion mode docs](/docs/concepts/workloads/controllers/job#completion-mode) and [StatefulSet pod index label docs](/docs/concepts/workloads/controllers/statefulset/#pod-index-label) for more details.

Feature gate PodLevelResourceManagers: alpha from 1.36 to 1.36; beta from 1.37. The gate is active. Enable _Pod-level resource managers_: the ability for the Topology, CPU, and
Memory managers to use information from `.spec.resources` to perform NUMA
alignment for an entire pod and manage resources flexibly for the containers
within that pod.

Feature gate PodLevelResources: alpha from 1.32 to 1.33; beta from 1.34. The gate is active. Enable _Pod level resources_:  the ability to specify resource requests and limits
at the Pod level, rather than only for specific containers.

Feature gate PodLifecycleSleepAction: alpha from 1.29 to 1.29; beta from 1.30 to 1.33; stable from 1.34. The gate is active. Enables the `sleep` action in Container lifecycle hooks (`preStop` and `postStart`).

Feature gate PodLifecycleSleepActionAllowZero: alpha from 1.32 to 1.32; beta from 1.33 to 1.33; stable from 1.34. The gate is active. Enables setting zero value for the `sleep` action in
[container lifecycle hooks](/docs/concepts/containers/container-lifecycle-hooks/).
Feature gate PodLogsQuerySplitStreams: alpha from 1.32. The gate is active. Enable fetching specific log streams (either stdout or stderr) from a container's log streams, using the Pod API.

Feature gate PodObservedGenerationTracking: alpha from 1.33 to 1.33; beta from 1.34 to 1.34; stable from 1.35. The gate is active. Enables the kubelet to set `observedGeneration` in the Pod `.status`, and enables other components to set `observedGeneration` in pod conditions.
This feature allows reflecting the `.metadata.generation` of the Pod at the time that the overall status, or some specific condition, was being recorded.
Storing it helps avoid risks associated with _lost updates_.

Feature gate PodOverhead: alpha from 1.16 to 1.17; beta from 1.18 to 1.23; stable from 1.24 to 1.25. The gate was removed. Enable the [PodOverhead](/docs/concepts/scheduling-eviction/pod-overhead/)
feature to account for pod overheads.

Feature gate PodPriority: alpha from 1.8 to 1.10; beta from 1.11 to 1.13; stable from 1.14 to 1.18. The gate was removed. Enable the descheduling and preemption of Pods based on their
[priorities](/docs/concepts/scheduling-eviction/pod-priority-preemption/).

Feature gate PodReadinessGates: alpha from 1.11 to 1.11; beta from 1.12 to 1.13; stable from 1.14 to 1.16. The gate was removed. Enable the setting of `PodReadinessGate` field for extending
Pod readiness evaluation. See [Pod readiness gate](/docs/concepts/workloads/pods/pod-lifecycle/#pod-readiness-gate)
for more details.

Feature gate PodReadyToStartContainersCondition: alpha from 1.28 to 1.28; beta from 1.29 to 1.36; stable from 1.37. The gate is active. Enable the kubelet to mark the [PodReadyToStartContainers](/docs/concepts/workloads/pods/pod-lifecycle/#pod-has-network) condition on pods.

This feature gate was previously known as `PodHasNetworkCondition`, and the associated condition was
named `PodHasNetwork`.

Feature gate PodSchedulingReadiness: alpha from 1.26 to 1.26; beta from 1.27 to 1.29; stable from 1.30. The gate is active. Enable setting `schedulingGates` field to control a Pod's [scheduling readiness](/docs/concepts/scheduling-eviction/pod-scheduling-readiness).
Feature gate PodSecurity: alpha from 1.22 to 1.22; beta from 1.23 to 1.24; stable from 1.25 to 1.27. The gate was removed. Enables the `PodSecurity` admission plugin.

Feature gate PodShareProcessNamespace: alpha from 1.10 to 1.11; beta from 1.12 to 1.16; stable from 1.17 to 1.19. The gate was removed. Enable the setting of `shareProcessNamespace` in a Pod for sharing
a single process namespace between containers running in a pod.  More details can be found in
[Share Process Namespace between Containers in a Pod](/docs/tasks/configure-pod-container/share-process-namespace/).

Feature gate PodTopologyLabelsAdmission: alpha from 1.33 to 1.34; beta from 1.35. The gate is active. Enables the `PodTopologyLabels` admission plugin.
See [Pod Topology Labels](/docs/reference/access-authn-authz/admission-controllers#podtopologylabels)
for details.

Feature gate PodsAPI: alpha from 1.36 to 1.36; beta from 1.37. The gate is active. Enables the kubelet Pods API gRPC service.
See [Kubelet Pods API](/docs/reference/node/kubelet-pods-api/) for more details.

Feature gate PortForwardWebsockets: alpha from 1.30 to 1.30; beta from 1.31. The gate is active. Allow WebSocket streaming of the
portforward sub-protocol (`port-forward`) from clients requesting
version v2 (`v2.portforward.k8s.io`) of the sub-protocol.

Feature gate PreferNominatedNode: alpha from 1.21 to 1.21; beta from 1.22 to 1.23; stable from 1.24 to 1.25. The gate was removed. This flag tells the scheduler whether the nominated
nodes will be checked first before looping through all the other nodes in
the cluster.

Feature gate PreferSameTrafficDistribution: alpha from 1.33 to 1.33; beta from 1.34 to 1.34; stable from 1.35. The gate is active. Allows usage of the values `PreferSameZone` and `PreferSameNode` in
the Service [`trafficDistribution`](/docs/reference/networking/virtual-ips/#traffic-distribution)
field.
Feature gate PreventStaticPodAPIReferences: beta from 1.34. The gate is active. Denies Pod admission if static Pods reference other API objects.

Feature gate ProbeTerminationGracePeriod: alpha from 1.21 to 1.21; beta from 1.22 to 1.24; beta from 1.25 to 1.27; stable from 1.28 to 1.28. The gate was removed. Enable [setting probe-level
`terminationGracePeriodSeconds`](/docs/tasks/configure-pod-container/configure-liveness-readiness-startup-probes/#probe-level-terminationgraceperiodseconds)
on pods. See the [enhancement proposal](https://github.com/kubernetes/enhancements/tree/master/keps/sig-node/2238-liveness-probe-grace-period)
for more details.

Feature gate ProcMountType: alpha from 1.12 to 1.30; beta from 1.31 to 1.32; beta from 1.33 to 1.35; stable from 1.36. The gate is active. Enables control over the type proc mounts for containers
by setting the `procMount` field of a Pod's `securityContext`.

Feature gate ProxyTerminatingEndpoints: alpha from 1.22 to 1.25; beta from 1.26 to 1.27; stable from 1.28 to 1.29. The gate was removed. Enable the kube-proxy to handle terminating
endpoints when `ExternalTrafficPolicy=Local`.

Feature gate QOSReserved: alpha from 1.11. The gate is active. Allows resource reservations at the QoS level preventing pods
at lower QoS levels from bursting into resources requested at higher QoS levels
(memory only for now).

Feature gate ReadOnlyAPIDataVolumes: beta from 1.8 to 1.9; stable from 1.10 to 1.10. The gate was removed. Set [`configMap`](/docs/concepts/storage/volumes/#configmap), 
[`secret`](/docs/concepts/storage/volumes/#secret), 
[`downwardAPI`](/docs/concepts/storage/volumes/#downwardapi) and 
[`projected`](/docs/concepts/storage/volumes/#projected) 
{{< glossary_tooltip term_id="volume" text="volumes" >}} to be mounted read-only.

Since Kubernetes v1.10, these volume types are always read-only and you cannot opt out.

Feature gate ReadWriteOncePod: alpha from 1.22 to 1.26; beta from 1.27 to 1.28; stable from 1.29 to 1.30. The gate was removed. Enables the usage of `ReadWriteOncePod` PersistentVolume
access mode.

Feature gate RecoverVolumeExpansionFailure: alpha from 1.23 to 1.31; beta from 1.32 to 1.33; stable from 1.34. The gate is active. Enables users to edit their PVCs to smaller
sizes so as they can recover from previously issued volume expansion failures.
See [Recovering from Failure when Expanding Volumes](/docs/concepts/storage/persistent-volumes/#recovering-from-failure-when-expanding-volumes)
for more details.

Feature gate RecursiveReadOnlyMounts: alpha from 1.30 to 1.30; beta from 1.31 to 1.32; stable from 1.33. The gate is active. Enables support for recursive read-only mounts.
For more details, see [read-only mounts](/docs/concepts/storage/volumes/#read-only-mounts).

Feature gate ReduceDefaultCrashLoopBackOffDecay: alpha from 1.33. The gate is active. Enabled reduction of both the initial delay and the maximum delay accrued
between container restarts for a node for containers in `CrashLoopBackOff`
across the cluster to `1s` initial delay and `60s` maximum delay.

Feature gate RelaxedDNSSearchValidation: alpha from 1.32 to 1.32; beta from 1.33 to 1.33; stable from 1.34 to 1.36. The gate was removed. Relax the server side validation for the DNS search string
(`.spec.dnsConfig.searches`) for containers. For example,
with this gate enabled, it is okay to include the `_` character
in the DNS name search string.

Feature gate RelaxedEnvironmentVariableValidation: alpha from 1.30 to 1.31; beta from 1.32 to 1.33; stable from 1.34. The gate is active. Allow almost all printable ASCII characters in environment variables.

Feature gate RelaxedServiceNameValidation: alpha from 1.34 to 1.35; beta from 1.36 to 1.36; stable from 1.37. The gate is active. Enables relaxed validation for Service object names, allowing the use of [RFC 1123 label names](/docs/concepts/overview/working-with-objects/names/#dns-label-names) instead of [RFC 1035 label names](/docs/concepts/overview/working-with-objects/names/#rfc-1035-label-names).

This feature allows Service object names to start with a digit.

Feature gate ReloadKubeletServerCertificateFile: beta from 1.31. The gate is active. Enable the kubelet TLS server to update its certificate if the specified certificate file are changed.

This feature is useful when specifying `tlsCertFile` and `tlsPrivateKeyFile` in kubelet configuration.
The feature gate has no effect for other cases such as using TLS bootstrap.

Feature gate RemainingItemCount: alpha from 1.15 to 1.15; beta from 1.16 to 1.28; stable from 1.29 to 1.32. The gate was removed. Allow the API servers to show a count of remaining
items in the response to a
[chunking list request](/docs/reference/using-api/api-concepts/#retrieving-large-results-sets-in-chunks).

Feature gate RemoteRequestHeaderUID: alpha from 1.32. The gate is active. Enable the API server to accept UIDs (user IDs) via request header authentication.
This will also make the `kube-apiserver`'s API aggregator add UIDs via standard headers when
forwarding requests to the servers serving the aggregated API.

Feature gate RemoveSelfLink: alpha from 1.16 to 1.19; beta from 1.20 to 1.23; stable from 1.24 to 1.29. The gate was removed. Sets the `.metadata.selfLink` field to blank (empty string) for all
objects and collections. This field has been deprecated since the Kubernetes v1.16
release. When this feature is enabled, the `.metadata.selfLink` field remains part of
the Kubernetes API, but is always unset.

Feature gate RequestManagement: alpha from 1.15 to 1.16; deprecated from 1.17 to 1.17. The gate was removed. Enables managing request concurrency with prioritization and fairness
at each API server. Deprecated by `APIPriorityAndFairness` since 1.17.
Feature gate ResilientWatchCacheInitialization: beta from 1.31 to 1.33; stable from 1.34. The gate is active. Enables resilient watchcache initialization to avoid controlplane overload.

Feature gate ResourceHealthStatus: alpha from 1.31 to 1.35; beta from 1.36. The gate is active. Enable the `allocatedResourcesStatus` field within the `.status` for a Pod. The field
reports additional details for each container in the Pod,
with the health information for each device assigned to the Pod.

Starting in v1.36 (beta), the health report includes an optional `message` field that
provides additional human-readable context about the health status, such as error details
or failure reasons.

This feature applies to devices managed by both [Device Plugins](/docs/concepts/extend-kubern

Feature gate ResourceLimitsPriorityFunction: alpha from 1.9 to 1.18; deprecated from 1.19 to 1.19. The gate was removed. Enable a scheduler priority function that
assigns a lowest possible score of 1 to a node that satisfies at least one of
the input Pod's cpu and memory limits. The intent is to break ties between
nodes with same scores.
Feature gate ResourceQuotaScopeSelectors: alpha from 1.11 to 1.11; beta from 1.12 to 1.16; stable from 1.17 to 1.18. The gate was removed. Enable resource quota scope selectors.

Feature gate RestartAllContainersOnContainerExits: alpha from 1.35 to 1.35; beta from 1.36. The gate is active. Enables the ability to specify
`RestartAllContainers` as an action in container `restartPolicyRules`. When a container's exit matches a rule with this action, the entire Pod is terminated and restarted in-place.

`RestartAllContainersOnContainerExits` depends on both the `ContainerRestartRules` and `NodeDeclaredFeatures` feature gates. If the dependent feature gates are not enabled, kubelet startup can fail.

See [Restart All Containers](/docs/concepts/workloads/pods/pod-lifecycle/#restart-all-c

Feature gate RetroactiveDefaultStorageClass: alpha from 1.25 to 1.25; beta from 1.26 to 1.27; stable from 1.28 to 1.28. The gate was removed. Allow assigning StorageClass to unbound PVCs retroactively.

Feature gate RetryGenerateName: alpha from 1.30 to 1.30; beta from 1.31 to 1.31; stable from 1.32. The gate is active. Enables retrying of object creation when the
{{< glossary_tooltip text="API server" term_id="kube-apiserver" >}}
is expected to generate a [name](/docs/concepts/overview/working-with-objects/names/#names).

When this feature is enabled, requests using `generateName` are retried automatically in case the
control plane detects a name conflict with an existing object, up to a limit of 8 total attempts.

Feature gate RootCAConfigMap: alpha from 1.13 to 1.19; beta from 1.20 to 1.20; stable from 1.21 to 1.22. The gate was removed. Configure the `kube-controller-manager` to publish a
{{< glossary_tooltip text="ConfigMap" term_id="configmap" >}} named `kube-root-ca.crt`
to every namespace. This ConfigMap contains a CA bundle used for verifying connections
to the kube-apiserver. See
[Bound Service Account Tokens](https://github.com/kubernetes/enhancements/blob/master/keps/sig-auth/1205-bound-service-account-tokens/README.md)
for more details.

Feature gate RotateKubeletClientCertificate: beta from 1.8 to 1.18; stable from 1.19 to 1.21. The gate was removed. Enable the rotation of the client TLS certificate on the kubelet.
See [kubelet configuration](/docs/reference/access-authn-authz/kubelet-tls-bootstrapping/#kubelet-configuration)
for more details.

Feature gate RotateKubeletServerCertificate: alpha from 1.7 to 1.11; beta from 1.12. The gate is active. Enable the rotation of the server TLS certificate on the kubelet.
See [kubelet configuration](/docs/reference/access-authn-authz/kubelet-tls-bootstrapping/#kubelet-configuration)
for more details.
Feature gate RunAsGroup: beta from 1.14 to 1.20; stable from 1.21 to 1.22. The gate was removed. Enable control over the primary group ID set on the init processes of containers.

Feature gate RuntimeClass: alpha from 1.12 to 1.13; beta from 1.14 to 1.19; stable from 1.20 to 1.24. The gate was removed. Enable the [RuntimeClass](/docs/concepts/containers/runtime-class/) feature for
selecting container runtime configurations.

Feature gate RuntimeClassInImageCriApi: alpha from 1.29. The gate is active. Enables images to be pulled based on the [runtime class](/docs/concepts/containers/runtime-class/)
of the pods that reference them.

Feature gate SCTPSupport: alpha from 1.12 to 1.18; beta from 1.19 to 1.19; stable from 1.20 to 1.22. The gate was removed. Enables the _SCTP_ `protocol` value in Pod, Service, Endpoints, EndpointSlice,
and NetworkPolicy definitions.

Feature gate SELinuxChangePolicy: alpha from 1.32 to 1.32; beta from 1.33 to 1.35; stable from 1.36. The gate is active. Enables `spec.securityContext.seLinuxChangePolicy` field.
This field can be used to opt-out from applying the SELinux label to the pod
volumes using mount options. This is required when a single volume that supports
mounting with SELinux mount option is shared between Pods that have different
SELinux labels, such as a privileged and unprivileged Pods.

Enabling the `SELinuxChangePolicy` feature gate requires the feature gate `SELinuxMountReadWriteOncePod` to
be enabled.

Feature gate SELinuxMount: alpha from 1.30 to 1.32; beta from 1.33 to 1.36; stable from 1.37. The gate is active. Speeds up container startup by allowing kubelet to mount volumes
for a Pod directly with the correct SELinux label instead of changing each file on the volumes
recursively.
It widens the performance improvements behind the `SELinuxMountReadWriteOncePod`
feature gate by extending the implementation to all volumes.

Feature gate SELinuxMountReadWriteOncePod: alpha from 1.25 to 1.26; beta from 1.27 to 1.27; beta from 1.28 to 1.35; stable from 1.36. The gate is active. Speeds up container startup by allowing kubelet to mount volumes
for a Pod directly with the correct SELinux label instead of changing each file on the volumes
recursively. The initial implementation focused on ReadWriteOncePod volumes.

Feature gate ScheduleDaemonSetPods: alpha from 1.11 to 1.11; beta from 1.12 to 1.16; stable from 1.17 to 1.18. The gate was removed. Enable DaemonSet Pods to be scheduled by the default scheduler instead
of the DaemonSet controller.

Feature gate SchedulerAsyncAPICalls: beta from 1.34. The gate is active. Change the kube-scheduler to make the entire scheduling cycle free of blocking requests to the Kubernetes API server.
Instead, interact with the Kubernetes API using asynchronous code.

Feature gate SchedulerAsyncPreemption: alpha from 1.32 to 1.32; beta from 1.33. The gate is active. Enable running some expensive operations within the scheduler, associated with
[preemption](/docs/concepts/scheduling-eviction/pod-priority-preemption/), asynchronously.
Asynchronous processing of preemption improves overall Pod scheduling latency.

Feature gate SchedulerPopFromBackoffQ: beta from 1.33. The gate is active. Improves scheduling queue behavior by popping pods from the backoffQ when the activeQ is empty.
This allows to process potentially schedulable pods ASAP, eliminating a penalty effect of the backoff queue.

Feature gate SchedulerQueueingHints: beta from 1.28 to 1.28; beta from 1.29 to 1.31; beta from 1.32 to 1.33; stable from 1.34. The gate is active. Enables scheduler [queueing hints](/docs/concepts/scheduling-eviction/scheduling-framework/#queueinghint),
which benefits to reduce the useless requeuing.
The scheduler retries scheduling pods if something changes in the cluster that could make the pod scheduled.
Queueing hints are internal signals that allow the scheduler to filter the changes in the cluster
that are relevant to the unscheduled pod, based on previous scheduling attempts.

Feature gate SeccompDefault: alpha from 1.22 to 1.24; beta from 1.25 to 1.26; stable from 1.27 to 1.28. The gate was removed. Enables the use of `RuntimeDefault` as the default seccomp profile
for all workloads.
The seccomp profile is specified in the `securityContext` of a Pod and/or a Container.
Feature gate SecurityContextDeny: alpha from 1.27 to 1.29. The gate was removed. This gate signals that the `SecurityContextDeny` admission controller is deprecated.

Feature gate SelectorIndex: alpha from 1.18 to 1.18; beta from 1.19 to 1.19; stable from 1.20 to 1.25. The gate was removed. Allows label and field based indexes in API server watch cache to accelerate
list operations.

Feature gate SeparateCacheWatchRPC: beta from 1.28 to 1.32; deprecated from 1.33. The gate is active. Allows the API server watch cache to create a watch on a dedicated RPC.
This prevents watch cache from being starved by other watches.

Feature gate SeparateTaintEvictionController: beta from 1.29 to 1.33; stable from 1.34. The gate is active. Enables running the _taint based eviction_ controller,
that performs [Taint-based Evictions](/docs/concepts/scheduling-eviction/taint-and-toleration/#taint-based-evictions),
as a standalone controller (separate from the _node lifecycle_ controller).

Feature gate ServerSideApply: alpha from 1.14 to 1.15; beta from 1.16 to 1.21; stable from 1.22 to 1.31. The gate was removed. Enables the [Sever Side Apply (SSA)](/docs/reference/using-api/server-side-apply/)
feature on the API Server.

Feature gate ServerSideFieldValidation: alpha from 1.23 to 1.24; beta from 1.25 to 1.26; stable from 1.27 to 1.31. The gate was removed. Enables server-side field validation. This means the validation
of resource schema is performed at the API server side rather than the client side
(for example, the `kubectl create` or `kubectl apply` command line).

Feature gate ServiceAccountIssuerDiscovery: alpha from 1.18 to 1.19; beta from 1.20 to 1.20; stable from 1.21 to 1.23. The gate was removed. Enable OIDC discovery endpoints (issuer and JWKS URLs) for the
service account issuer in the API server. See
