[Configure Service Accounts for Pods](/docs/tasks/configure-pod-container/configure-service-account/#service-account-issuer-discovery)
for more details.

Feature gate ServiceAccountNodeAudienceRestriction: beta from 1.32 to 1.32; beta from 1.33. The gate is active. This gate is used to restrict the audience for which the kubelet can request a service account token for.

Feature gate ServiceAccountTokenJTI: alpha from 1.29 to 1.29; beta from 1.30 to 1.31; stable from 1.32. The gate is active. Controls whether JTIs (UUIDs) are embedded into generated service account tokens,
and whether these JTIs are recorded into the Kubernetes audit log for future requests made by these tokens.

Feature gate ServiceAccountTokenNodeBinding: alpha from 1.29 to 1.30; beta from 1.31 to 1.32; stable from 1.33. The gate is active. Controls whether the API server allows binding service account tokens to Node objects.

Feature gate ServiceAccountTokenNodeBindingValidation: alpha from 1.29 to 1.29; beta from 1.30 to 1.31; stable from 1.32. The gate is active. Controls whether the apiserver will validate a Node reference in service account tokens.

Feature gate ServiceAccountTokenPodNodeInfo: alpha from 1.29 to 1.29; beta from 1.30 to 1.31; stable from 1.32. The gate is active. Controls whether the apiserver embeds the node name and uid
for the associated node when issuing service account tokens bound to Pod objects.
Feature gate ServiceAppProtocol: alpha from 1.18 to 1.18; beta from 1.19 to 1.19; stable from 1.20 to 1.22. The gate was removed. Enables the `appProtocol` field on Services and Endpoints.

Feature gate ServiceIPStaticSubrange: alpha from 1.24 to 1.24; beta from 1.25 to 1.25; stable from 1.26 to 1.27. The gate was removed. Enables a strategy for Services ClusterIP allocations, whereby the
ClusterIP range is subdivided. Dynamic allocated ClusterIP addresses will be allocated preferently
from the upper range allowing users to assign static ClusterIPs from the lower range with a low
risk of collision. See
[Avoiding collisions](/docs/reference/networking/virtual-ips/#avoiding-collisions)
for more details.
Feature gate ServiceInternalTrafficPolicy: alpha from 1.21 to 1.21; beta from 1.22 to 1.25; stable from 1.26 to 1.27. The gate was removed. Enables the `internalTrafficPolicy` field on Services
Feature gate ServiceLBNodePortControl: alpha from 1.20 to 1.21; beta from 1.22 to 1.23; stable from 1.24 to 1.25. The gate was removed. Enables the `allocateLoadBalancerNodePorts` field on Services.

Feature gate ServiceLoadBalancerClass: alpha from 1.21 to 1.21; beta from 1.22 to 1.23; stable from 1.24 to 1.25. The gate was removed. Enables the `loadBalancerClass` field on Services. See
[Specifying class of load balancer implementation](/docs/concepts/services-networking/service/#load-balancer-class)
for more details.
Feature gate ServiceLoadBalancerFinalizer: alpha from 1.15 to 1.15; beta from 1.16 to 1.16; stable from 1.17 to 1.20. The gate was removed. Enable finalizer protection for Service load balancers.

Feature gate ServiceNodeExclusion: alpha from 1.8 to 1.18; beta from 1.19 to 1.20; stable from 1.21 to 1.22. The gate was removed. Enable the exclusion of nodes from load balancers created by a cloud provider.
A node is eligible for exclusion if labelled with "`node.kubernetes.io/exclude-from-external-load-balancers`".

Feature gate ServiceNodePortStaticSubrange: alpha from 1.27 to 1.27; beta from 1.28 to 1.28; stable from 1.29 to 1.30. The gate was removed. Enables the use of different port allocation
strategies for NodePort Services. For more details, see
[reserve NodePort ranges to avoid collisions](/docs/concepts/services-networking/service/#avoid-nodeport-collisions).
Feature gate ServiceTopology: alpha from 1.17 to 1.19; deprecated from 1.20 to 1.22. The gate was removed. Enable service to route traffic based upon the Node topology of the cluster.

Feature gate ServiceTrafficDistribution: alpha from 1.30 to 1.30; beta from 1.31 to 1.32; stable from 1.33. The gate is active. Allows usage of the optional `spec.trafficDistribution` field in Services. The
field offers a way to express preferences for how traffic is distributed to
Service endpoints.

Feature gate SetHostnameAsFQDN: alpha from 1.19 to 1.19; beta from 1.20 to 1.21; stable from 1.22 to 1.24. The gate was removed. Enable the ability of setting Fully Qualified Domain Name(FQDN) as the
hostname of a pod. See
[Pod's `setHostnameAsFQDN` field](/docs/concepts/services-networking/dns-pod-service/#pod-sethostnameasfqdn-field).

Feature gate ShardedListAndWatch: alpha from 1.36. The gate is active. Enable support for the `shardSelector` parameter on **list** and **watch** requests,
allowing clients to receive a filtered subset of objects based on hash ranges of
metadata fields (such as UID). See
[Sharded list and watch](/docs/reference/using-api/api-concepts/#sharded-list-and-watch)
for more details.

Feature gate SidecarContainers: alpha from 1.28 to 1.28; beta from 1.29 to 1.32; stable from 1.33. The gate is active. Allow setting the `restartPolicy` of an init container to
`Always` so that the container becomes a sidecar container (restartable init containers).
See [Sidecar containers and restartPolicy](/docs/concepts/workloads/pods/sidecar-containers/)
for more details.
Feature gate SizeBasedListCostEstimate: beta from 1.34. The gate is active. Enables APF to use size of objects for estimating request cost.

Feature gate SizeMemoryBackedVolumes: alpha from 1.20 to 1.21; beta from 1.22 to 1.31; stable from 1.32 to 1.34. The gate was removed. Enable kubelets to determine the size limit for
memory-backed volumes (mainly `emptyDir` volumes).
Feature gate SkipReadOnlyValidationGCE: alpha from 1.28 to 1.28; deprecated from 1.29 to 1.30. The gate was removed. Skip validation that GCE PersistentDisk volumes are in read-only mode.

Feature gate StableLoadBalancerNodeSet: beta from 1.27 to 1.29; stable from 1.30 to 1.31. The gate was removed. Enables less load balancer re-configurations by
the service controller (KCCM) as an effect of changing node state.

Feature gate StaleControllerConsistencyDaemonSet: beta from 1.36. The gate is active. Enables behavior within the DaemonSet controller to ensure that prior writes to
the API server are observed before proceeding with additional reconciliation for the same DaemonSet.
This is to prevent stale cache from causing incorrect or spurious updates to the DaemonSet.

Feature gate StaleControllerConsistencyJob: beta from 1.36. The gate is active. Enables behavior within the Job controller to ensure that prior writes to
the API server are observed before proceeding with additional reconciliation for the same Job.
This is to prevent stale cache from causing incorrect or spurious updates to the Job.

Feature gate StaleControllerConsistencyReplicaSet: beta from 1.36. The gate is active. Enables behavior within the ReplicaSet controller to ensure that prior writes to
the API server are observed before proceeding with additional reconciliation for the same ReplicaSet.
This is to prevent stale cache from causing incorrect or spurious updates to the ReplicaSet.

Feature gate StaleControllerConsistencyStatefulSet: beta from 1.36. The gate is active. Enables behavior within the StatefulSet controller to ensure that prior writes to
the API server are observed before proceeding with additional reconciliation for the same StatefulSet.
This is to prevent stale cache from causing incorrect or spurious updates to the StatefulSet.

Feature gate StartupProbe: alpha from 1.16 to 1.17; beta from 1.18 to 1.19; stable from 1.20 to 1.23. The gate was removed. Enable the [startup](/docs/concepts/workloads/pods/pod-lifecycle/#when-should-you-use-a-startup-probe)
probe in the kubelet.

Feature gate StatefulSetAutoDeletePVC: alpha from 1.23 to 1.26; beta from 1.27 to 1.31; stable from 1.32. The gate is active. Allows the use of the optional `.spec.persistentVolumeClaimRetentionPolicy` field, 
providing control over the deletion of PVCs in a StatefulSet's lifecycle.
See
[PersistentVolumeClaim retention](/docs/concepts/workloads/controllers/statefulset/#persistentvolumeclaim-retention)
for more details.

Feature gate StatefulSetMinReadySeconds: alpha from 1.22 to 1.22; beta from 1.23 to 1.24; stable from 1.25 to 1.26. The gate was removed. Allows `minReadySeconds` to be respected by
the StatefulSet controller.

Feature gate StatefulSetRecreateStrategy: alpha from 1.37. The gate is active. Enables the `Recreate` update strategy for StatefulSets, which deletes all of a
StatefulSet's Pods before creating new Pods that reflect modifications made to the
StatefulSet's `.spec.template`. See
[Recreate](/docs/concepts/workloads/controllers/statefulset/#recreate) for details.

Feature gate StatefulSetStartOrdinal: alpha from 1.26 to 1.26; beta from 1.27 to 1.30; stable from 1.31. The gate is active. Allow configuration of the start ordinal in a
StatefulSet. See
[Start ordinal](/docs/concepts/workloads/controllers/statefulset/#start-ordinal)
for more details.

Feature gate StorageCapacityScoring: alpha from 1.33 to 1.36; beta from 1.37. The gate is active. The feature gate `VolumeCapacityPriority` was used in v1.32 to support storage that are
statically provisioned. Starting from v1.33, the new feature gate `StorageCapacityScoring`
replaces the old `VolumeCapacityPriority` gate with added support to dynamically provisioned storage.
When `StorageCapacityScoring` is enabled, the VolumeBinding plugin in the kube-scheduler is extended
to score Nodes based on the storage capacity on each of them.
This feature is applicable to CSI volumes that supported

Feature gate StorageNamespaceIndex: beta from 1.30 to 1.32; deprecated from 1.33. The gate is active. Enables a namespace indexer for namespace scoped resources
in API server cache to accelerate list operations.

Feature gate StorageObjectInUseProtection: beta from 1.10 to 1.10; stable from 1.11 to 1.24. The gate was removed. Postpone the deletion of PersistentVolume or
PersistentVolumeClaim objects if they are still being used.

Feature gate StorageVersionAPI: alpha from 1.20. The gate is active. Enable the
[storage version API](/docs/reference/generated/kubernetes-api/{{< param "version" >}}/#storageversion-v1alpha1-internal-apiserver-k8s-io).

Feature gate StorageVersionHash: alpha from 1.14 to 1.14; beta from 1.15. The gate is active. Allow API servers to expose the storage version hash in the
discovery.

Feature gate StorageVersionMigrator: alpha from 1.30 to 1.34; beta from 1.35. The gate is active. Enables the migration of the [storage
version](/docs/concepts/overview/working-with-objects/storage-version) of a
resource.

Feature gate StreamingCollectionEncodingToJSON: beta from 1.33 to 1.33; stable from 1.34. The gate is active. Allow the API server JSON encoder to encode collections item by item, instead of all at once.

Feature gate StreamingCollectionEncodingToProtobuf: alpha from 1.33 to 1.33; stable from 1.34. The gate is active. Allow the API server Protobuf encoder to encode collections item by item, instead of all at once.

Feature gate StreamingProxyRedirects: beta from 1.5 to 1.5; beta from 1.6 to 1.17; deprecated from 1.18 to 1.21; deprecated from 1.22 to 1.24. The gate was removed. Instructs the API server to intercept (and follow) redirects from the
backend (kubelet) for streaming requests. Examples of streaming requests include the `exec`,
`attach` and `port-forward` requests.
Feature gate StrictCostEnforcementForVAP: beta from 1.30 to 1.31; stable from 1.32. The gate is active. Apply strict CEL cost validation for ValidatingAdmissionPolicies.

Feature gate StrictCostEnforcementForWebhooks: beta from 1.31 to 1.31; stable from 1.32. The gate is active. Apply strict CEL cost validation for `matchConditions` within
admission webhooks.

Feature gate StrictIPCIDRValidation: alpha from 1.33 to 1.35; beta from 1.36. The gate is active. Use stricter validation for fields containing IP addresses and CIDR values.

In particular, with this feature gate enabled, octets within IPv4 addresses are
not allowed to have any leading `0`s, and IPv4-mapped IPv6 values (e.g.
`::ffff:192.168.0.1`) are forbidden. These sorts of values can potentially cause
security problems when different components interpret the same string as
referring to different IP addresses (as in CVE-2021-29923).

This tightening applies only to fields in build-in API k

Feature gate StructuredAuthenticationConfiguration: alpha from 1.29 to 1.29; beta from 1.30 to 1.33; stable from 1.34. The gate is active. Enable [structured authentication configuration](/docs/reference/access-authn-authz/authentication/#configuring-the-api-server)
for the API server.
Feature gate StructuredAuthenticationConfigurationEgressSelector: beta from 1.34. The gate is active. Enables Egress Selector in Structured Authentication Configuration.

Feature gate StructuredAuthenticationConfigurationJWKSMetrics: beta from 1.35. The gate is active. Enables additional metrics for JSON Web Key Set (JWKS) operations in JWT authenticators
configured via `--authentication-config`. When enabled, the API server records metrics about
the last time JWKS was fetched and the hash value of the JWKS response.
See the [metrics reference](/docs/reference/instrumentation/metrics/) for details.

Feature gate StructuredAuthorizationConfiguration: alpha from 1.29 to 1.29; beta from 1.30 to 1.31; stable from 1.32. The gate is active. Enable structured authorization configuration, so that cluster administrators
can specify more than one [authorization webhook](/docs/reference/access-authn-authz/webhook/)
in the API server handler chain.

Feature gate SupplementalGroupsPolicy: alpha from 1.31 to 1.32; beta from 1.33. The gate is active. Enables support for fine-grained SupplementalGroups control.
For more details, see [Configure fine-grained SupplementalGroups control for a Pod](/docs/tasks/configure-pod-container/security-context/#supplementalgroupspolicy).

Feature gate SupportIPVSProxyMode: alpha from 1.8 to 1.8; beta from 1.9 to 1.9; beta from 1.10 to 1.10; stable from 1.11 to 1.20. The gate was removed. Enable providing in-cluster service load balancing using IPVS.
See [service proxies](/docs/reference/networking/virtual-ips/) for more details.

Feature gate SupportNodePidsLimit: alpha from 1.14 to 1.14; beta from 1.15 to 1.19; stable from 1.20 to 1.23. The gate was removed. Enable the support to limiting PIDs on the Node.  The parameter
`pid=<number>` in the `--system-reserved` and `--kube-reserved` options can be specified to
ensure that the specified number of process IDs will be reserved for the system as a whole and for
 Kubernetes system daemons respectively.
Feature gate SupportPodPidsLimit: alpha from 1.10 to 1.13; beta from 1.14 to 1.19; stable from 1.20 to 1.23. The gate was removed. Enable the support to limiting PIDs in Pods.

Feature gate SuspendJob: alpha from 1.21 to 1.21; beta from 1.22 to 1.23; stable from 1.24 to 1.25. The gate was removed. Enable support to suspend and resume Jobs. For more details, see
 [the Jobs docs](/docs/concepts/workloads/controllers/job/).

Feature gate Sysctls: beta from 1.11 to 1.20; stable from 1.21 to 1.22. The gate was removed. Enable support for namespaced kernel parameters (sysctls) that can be set for each pod.
See [sysctls](/docs/tasks/administer-cluster/sysctl-cluster/) for more details.

Feature gate SystemdWatchdog: beta from 1.32. The gate is active. Allow using systemd watchdog to monitor the health status of kubelet.
See [Kubelet Systemd Watchdog](/docs/reference/node/systemd-watchdog/)
for more details.

Feature gate TTLAfterFinished: alpha from 1.12 to 1.20; beta from 1.21 to 1.22; stable from 1.23 to 1.24. The gate was removed. Allow a [TTL controller](/docs/concepts/workloads/controllers/ttlafterfinished/)
to clean up resources after they finish execution.

Feature gate TaintBasedEvictions: alpha from 1.6 to 1.12; beta from 1.13 to 1.17; stable from 1.18 to 1.20. The gate was removed. Enable evicting pods from nodes based on taints on Nodes and tolerations
on Pods.  See [taints and tolerations](/docs/concepts/scheduling-eviction/taint-and-toleration/)
for more details.

Feature gate TaintNodesByCondition: alpha from 1.8 to 1.11; beta from 1.12 to 1.16; stable from 1.17 to 1.18. The gate was removed. Enable automatic tainting nodes based on
[node conditions](/docs/concepts/architecture/nodes/#condition).

Feature gate TaintTolerationComparisonOperators: alpha from 1.35. The gate is active. Enables numeric comparison operators (`Lt` and `Gt`) for
[tolerations](/docs/concepts/scheduling-eviction/taint-and-toleration/).
Feature gate TokenRequest: alpha from 1.10 to 1.11; beta from 1.12 to 1.19; stable from 1.20 to 1.21. The gate was removed. Enable the `TokenRequest` endpoint on service account resources.

Feature gate TokenRequestProjection: alpha from 1.11 to 1.11; beta from 1.12 to 1.19; stable from 1.20 to 1.21. The gate was removed. Enable the injection of service account tokens into a Pod through a
[`projected` volume](/docs/concepts/storage/volumes/#projected).

Feature gate TokenRequestServiceAccountUIDValidation: beta from 1.34. The gate is active. This is used to ensure that the UID provided in the TokenRequest matches
the UID of the ServiceAccount for which the token is being requested.
It helps prevent misuse of the TokenRequest API by ensuring that
tokens are only issued for the correct ServiceAccount.

Feature gate TopologyAwareHints: alpha from 1.21 to 1.22; beta from 1.23 to 1.23; beta from 1.24 to 1.32; stable from 1.33 to 1.35. The gate was removed. Enables topology aware routing based on topology hints
in EndpointSlices. See [Topology Aware
Hints](/docs/concepts/services-networking/topology-aware-routing/) for more
details.
Feature gate TopologyAwareWorkloadScheduling: alpha from 1.36. The gate is active. Enable topology-aware scheduling for Workloads.

Feature gate TopologyManager: alpha from 1.16 to 1.17; beta from 1.18 to 1.26; stable from 1.27 to 1.28. The gate was removed. Enable a mechanism to coordinate fine-grained hardware resource
assignments for different components in Kubernetes. See
[Control Topology Management Policies on a node](/docs/tasks/administer-cluster/topology-manager/).

Feature gate TopologyManagerPolicyAlphaOptions: alpha from 1.26. The gate is active. Allow fine-tuning of topology manager policies,
experimental, Alpha-quality options.
This feature gate guards *a group* of topology manager options whose quality level is alpha.
This feature gate will never graduate to beta or stable.

Feature gate TopologyManagerPolicyBetaOptions: beta from 1.26 to 1.27; beta from 1.28. The gate is active. Allow fine-tuning of topology manager policies,
experimental, Beta-quality options.
This feature gate guards *a group* of topology manager options whose quality level is beta.
This feature gate will never graduate to stable.

Feature gate TopologyManagerPolicyOptions: alpha from 1.26 to 1.27; beta from 1.28 to 1.31; stable from 1.32. The gate is active. Enable [fine-tuning](/docs/tasks/administer-cluster/topology-manager/#topology-manager-policy-options)
of topology manager policies.

Feature gate TranslateStreamCloseWebsocketRequests: alpha from 1.29 to 1.29; beta from 1.30. The gate is active. Allow WebSocket streaming of the
remote command sub-protocol (`exec`, `cp`, `attach`) from clients requesting
version 5 (v5) of the sub-protocol.

Feature gate UnauthenticatedHTTP2DOSMitigation: beta from 1.28 to 1.28; beta from 1.29. The gate is active. Enables HTTP/2 Denial of Service (DoS) mitigations for unauthenticated clients.
Kubernetes v1.28.0 through v1.28.2 do not include this feature gate.

Feature gate UnknownVersionInteroperabilityProxy: alpha from 1.28 to 1.35; beta from 1.36. The gate is active. Proxy resource requests to the correct peer kube-apiserver when
multiple kube-apiservers exist at varied versions.
See [Mixed version proxy](/docs/concepts/architecture/mixed-version-proxy/) for more information.

Feature gate UnlockWhileProcessingFIFO: beta from 1.36. The gate is active. Enable use of a FIFO queue within client-go that unlocks while processing events. If not enabled, 
the queue instead holds the lock for the entire duration of processing events, which could lead 
to performance issues in high-throughput scenarios. This feature gate can be toggled in the
kube-controller-manager and any client-go based controller.

You can only enable this feature gate if the
[AtomicFIFO](/docs/reference/command-line-tools-reference/feature-gates/#AtomicFIFO) feature gate is also

Feature gate UserNamespacesHostNetworkSupport: alpha from 1.35. The gate is active. When enabled, pods are allowed to use both `hostNetwork` and [User Namespaces](/docs/concepts/workloads/pods/user-namespaces) simultaneously.

Feature gate UserNamespacesPodSecurityStandards: alpha from 1.29 to 1.34. The gate was removed. Enable Pod Security Standards policies relaxation for pods
that run with namespaces. You must set the value of this feature gate consistently across all nodes in
your cluster, and you must also enable `UserNamespacesSupport` to use this feature.

This feature gate is not part of Kubernetes v1.35 (and onwards) because,
for those versions of Kubernetes, all supported kubelet versions will fail to
